About us

A family name in building plastics.

Our story

Swift Building Plastics.

Swift is the new name from the team behind Essex uPVC — the same people, the same yard, now supplying the Freefoam and Freeflow ranges.

We supply the full roofline and rainwater range — fascia, soffit, cover boards, cladding, guttering and downpipes — to developers, roofing contractors and homeowners alike. Everything is domestic-scale, matched across one system, and backed by manufacturer guarantees up to 50 years.

What hasn't changed is how we work: pick up the phone, quote fast, and stand behind what we sell.

What we stand for

Three things we don't compromise on.

Customer service & focus

You deal directly with the family that runs the business. Fast quotes, straight answers, and someone who actually knows the product.

Family run

Swift is a family business and the sister company to Essex uPVC — years of roofline and rainwater experience behind every order.

Reliability

Backed by Freefoam & Freeflow: consistent stock, matched colours and guarantees up to 50 years. Kit that turns up and fits.
